name: traffic-light
description: A band above the prompt says whether the session's main work is done, side work in other checkouts aside: green before any work starts, and once its GitHub PR or GitLab MR is merged into an integration branch, or its commit pushed straight to one, and that push's pipeline passed; yellow while it waits on the PR, MR or pipeline, red when it needs you or can't read the forge. A Herdr subtask's pane closes a minute after its main work turns green, the band counting down with Keep open and Close now.
